mainEntity.name: Who pays for my medical bills after a rideshare accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: Responsibility for medical bills in a rideshare accident can be complex. Depending on the stage of the rideshare trip and the driver's actions, the rideshare company's insurance policy, the rideshare driver's personal insurance, or the at-fault driver's insurance may be liable. Often, rideshare companies carry significant insurance coverage for when a driver is engaged in a trip. A personal injury lawyer specializing in rideshare cases can help identify all potential sources of recovery and navigate claims to ensure your medical expenses are covered.
acceptedAnswer.description: Medical bills may be covered by the rideshare company's insurance, the driver's personal insurance, or the at-fault driver's insurance. A lawyer can help identify liable parties.
